assets.purpose: 16-bit UI frames, button states, resource and shop icons
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for the 16-bit occult dark fantasy FPS SIGIL BREACH. Create ONE square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, equal 256x256 cells, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines. Every object stays completely inside its cell. Design as carefully hand-placed low-resolution pixel art, strict visible square pixel clusters, originally 256x256 scaled up 4x nearest-neighbor, about 24 shared colors. No antialiasing, soft brush, blur, gradients, bloom, glow halos, painted concept art, chaotic ornamental filler, photorealism or perspective views. Front-facing game assets, consistent upper-left pixel lighting. Palette: near-black cold charcoal, worn blue-grey iron, tarnished muted brass, bone ivory; crimson health, cool blue armor, amber soul, violet essence. Readable at small size. First row has four square resizable UI plates that fill each entire cell, with 32px-wide borders, corners contained inside border and quiet almost-black opaque blank centers (no symbols in the centers): column1 dark hammered iron panel with restrained brass corner clamps; column2 unselected button bevel dark iron; column3 selected button same design with clear warm brass bevel and brighter inner edge; column4 disabled button same geometry dull charcoal bevel. Square corners, not rounded. Remaining twelve cells contain isolated icons centered with transparent padding, each icon roughly 160x160 within its cell and strong silhouette: row2 column1 crimson anatomical heart with simple ivory highlight, column2 blue-grey heater shield, column3 amber teardrop soul flame, column4 violet ring with a white four-point star; row3 column1 pair of red shotgun shells with brass caps, column2 blue arcane lance crystal head, column3 worn iron boot with two short speed chevrons, column4 bone demon skull; row4 column1 brass choke rune shaped as three lines converging into a narrow opening, column2 iron piercing dart crossing a split shield, column3 small ritual brazier with an ivory-orange flame, column4 broken brass signet ring with one missing segment. Make icons practical and recognisable instead of decorative paintings. Cohesive handcrafted 1990s 16-bit PC game aesthetic. No text anywhere.
